subject: Parks and Open Space Renovation Planning
overview: Host Danielle Balocca interviewed Alicia Hunt, Director of Planning, Development, and Sustainability, regarding ongoing park renovations and climate action planning. The meeting also included a recap of the municipal election results and feedback from local youth on city amenities.

items.title: Municipal Election Results Recap
items.summary: Host Danielle Balocca summarized the results of the 2021 municipal election, noting the re-election of Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn and several new members of the City Council and School Committee.

items.title: Climate Action and Adaptation Plan
items.summary: Director Alicia Hunt announced that the city's Climate Action and Adaptation Plan is currently open for public comment through January via the Go Green Medford website.

items.title: Carr Park Vision Plan
items.summary: The city is conducting a "clean slate" visioning process for Carr Park, with draft plans to be displayed for public feedback on November 13.

items.title: Gillis Park ADA Accessibility
items.summary: Consultants are designing legal ADA accessibility improvements for the Gillis Park baseball field to accommodate spectators with disabilities.

items.title: Morrison and Logan Park Improvements
items.summary: Planning is underway for toddler-specific play equipment at Morrison Park and natural play features at Logan Park, supported by ongoing community surveys.

items.title: Citywide Infrastructure and Sustainability Projects
items.summary: Hunt detailed various smaller projects, including a Route 28 underpass design, basketball court resurfacing, tree replacements, and LED lighting upgrades at public facilities.

items.title: Funding and Grant Opportunities
items.summary: The discussion highlighted the use of state, federal, and private grants for park renovations, including a $250,000 private grant for the Riverbend Park dog park.

items.title: Zoning Recodification Public Hearing Announcement
items.summary: The Community Development Board will host a public hearing via Zoom on November 18 to discuss the drafted proposed zoning ordinance.

items.title: Youth Community Feedback
items.summary: Local students Joe and Conrad provided feedback on Carr Park, expressing interest in hiking trails and field preservation, and discussed the upcoming library opening.
